name: flashscore
displayName: Flashscore football navigation and pair metadata
description: Public competition document pair navigation and identity/competition metadata for the fixture selected by a known football pair link. Pair links do not uniquely select a date or event.

operations.name: resolveFootballPairMetadata
operations.description: Resolve the fixture selected by a known Flashscore football team-pair link. Identity and competition metadata only; selection can change.

params.description: Second team slug-and-ID segment, copied in the original order from a public /match/football/ link. This is not home/away order.
